The '''Ord Radama Rebel Cell''' was a small [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] that was active on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Radama/Legends|Ord Radama]]. The Cell was led by [[Haril Zense]], and much of its activity took place in the [[Scarlet Sword]] [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]].<ref name="OAA1" />
